title: Mexican Tuna Kebabs
description: A flavorful and quick Mexican dish made with tuna, roasted vegetables, and a hint of Saudi Arabian spices.

ingredients.name: Roasted Vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, onions, and zucchini

ingredients.name: Saudi Arabian Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: such as cumin, coriander, and turmeric

instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together tuna, roasted vegetables, Saudi Arabian spice blend, lime juice, and chili powder (if using).
Thread the tuna mixture onto skewers.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the kebabs for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
Optional: Serve with a side of Mexican rice or beans.
